categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies net_processing, txdownloadman, txrequest, and txorphanage to fix transaction relay and orphan handling edge cases.
categories.rationale: Plugs multiple liveness vulnerabilities in 1-parent-1-child package relay where adversarial peers can prevent honest fee-bump packages from entering the mempool. As noted in commit 65b48ba1f1, an announcer disconnecting before orphan reconsideration previously left orphans unretried while preventing other announcers from refetching them, allowing peers to intentionally delay CPFP relay.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The fuzz harness and unit tests added specifically test p2p package relay behavior rather than general test infrastructure or runner machinery.
categories.rationale: Category covers general test runner, framework, and fuzzing machinery; tests of a specific subsystem's relay behavior belong to that subsystem.
